entries.en: The old travel diary describes a journey through Turkestan interrupted by a broken wagon.
entries.zh: 那本旧旅行日记记述了一次途经土耳其斯坦、因马车损坏而中断的旅程。

entries.en: Satie carried the folded chairs indoors while we collected the empty cups.
entries.zh: 我们收拾空杯子时，萨蒂把折叠椅搬进了室内。

entries.en: She left her sketchbook on Kyushu and did not notice until she unpacked at home.
entries.zh: 她把速写本落在了九州岛上，直到回家打开行李才发现。

entries.en: Capra held the ladder steady while we hung the curtains in the hall.
entries.zh: 我们在大厅挂窗帘时，卡普拉稳稳地扶着梯子。

entries.en: We compared two photographs of Mount Ararat before choosing one for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 我们比较了两张阿勒山的照片，再选出一张用于展览。

entries.en: Our friends in Adana offered to keep the suitcase until we returned.
entries.zh: 我们在亚达那的朋友提出替我们保管那个手提箱，直到我们回来。

entries.en: Several letters sent from Tientsin were missing from the family's nineteenth-century correspondence.
entries.zh: 那家人十九世纪的往来书信中，少了几封从天津寄出的信。

entries.en: Her unfinished travel memoir ends with a rainy afternoon on Principe Island.
entries.zh: 她尚未写完的旅行回忆录，以在普林西比岛度过的一个雨天午后收尾。

entries.en: We reached Kalamazoo without the address and had to telephone our hosts again.
entries.zh: 我们到达卡拉马祖时没有地址，只好再给接待我们的人打电话。

entries.en: Isolde wrapped the cups in newspaper while I looked for a stronger box.
entries.zh: 我找更结实的箱子时，伊索德用报纸包起了那些杯子。

entries.en: A Hani helped us arrange the photographs for the village's art exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位哈尼族人帮我们布置了村里艺术展上的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 卡德摩斯〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The actor playing Cadmus asked for more time to rehearse the final scene.
entries.zh: 扮演卡德摩斯的演员要求多留些时间排练最后一场戏。

entries.en: The torn photograph of the Yellowstone River remained tucked inside her travel notebook.
entries.zh: 那张撕破的黄石河照片一直夹在她的旅行笔记本里。

entries.en: Rebekah returned the borrowed blanket after washing it and repairing a small tear.
entries.zh: 丽贝卡洗好借来的毯子、补好一处小破口后，把它还了回去。

entries.en: The seminar on Petrarch left plenty of time for questions about the assigned reading.
entries.zh: 那场关于彼特拉克的研讨课留出了充足时间，供大家就指定阅读材料提问。

entries.en: Her letter from Gujarat arrived after we had already posted her birthday present.
entries.zh: 我们已经寄出她的生日礼物之后，她从古吉拉特邦写来的信才到。

entries.en: We put the photographs from Xinjiang in a separate envelope before packing the albums.
entries.zh: 我们先把来自新疆的照片放进另一个信封，再装相册。

entries.en: Odo offered us the spare room when heavy rain delayed our journey.
entries.zh: 大雨耽误了我们的行程，小渡提出让我们住那间空房。

entries.en: Melba borrowed a large saucepan because her own was too small for the soup.
entries.zh: 梅尔巴借了一口大炖锅，因为她自己的锅盛不下那些汤。

entries.en: She borrowed a book about Hesiod and took notes during the long train journey.
entries.zh: 她借了一本关于赫西奥德的书，在漫长的火车旅途中做了笔记。

entries.en: Gustavus checked every pocket before admitting that he had lost the key.
entries.zh: 古斯塔夫斯把每个口袋都检查了一遍，才承认自己把钥匙弄丢了。

entries.en: Glaser waited with the luggage while I went back for the forgotten umbrella.
entries.zh: 我回去取落下的伞时，格拉泽守着行李等候。

entries.en: The lecturer discussed Giacometti without assuming that everyone had visited the exhibition.
entries.zh: 讲师谈到贾科梅蒂时，没有假定每个人都参观过那场展览。

entries.en: The illustrator moved Cybele towards the centre of the composition before adding the background.
entries.zh: 插画师先把自然女神Cybele移到画面更靠中央的位置，再添上背景。

entries.en: Caruso found an extra blanket in the cupboard beside the stairs.
entries.zh: 卡鲁索在楼梯旁的柜子里找到了一条多余的毯子。

entries.en: Bessemer offered to repair the loose handle before we packed the suitcase.
entries.zh: 贝西默主动提出在我们装手提箱之前修好那个松动的把手。

entries.en: The historian questioned the film's treatment of the A-bomb and its human consequences.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家质疑了影片对原子弹及其给人类带来的后果的呈现方式。

entries.en: On the diagram, roots spread through the A-horizon beneath a layer of fallen leaves.
entries.zh: 图中，树根在落叶层下方的表土层中伸展开来。

entries.en: The report described the A-team's evacuation of civilians without discussing military tactics.
entries.zh: 报告描述了那支特遣队疏散平民的情况，没有讨论军事战术。

entries.en: We left a box of books with our friends in Aalborg rather than carry it home.
entries.zh: 我们把一箱书留在奥尔堡的朋友那里，没有把它带回家。

entries.en: The parcel she sent from Aalst contained a scarf and a handwritten recipe.
entries.zh: 她从阿尔斯特寄来的包裹里有一条围巾和一张手写食谱。

entries.en: The sketch of the Aar River was still damp when she closed the notebook.
entries.zh: 她合上笔记本时，那幅阿勒河速写还没有干。

entries.en: We arranged to meet in Aarhus but forgot to agree on a time.
entries.zh: 我们约好在奥尔胡斯见面，却忘了商定时间。

entries.en: She compared the AAS results for the two samples before preparing the laboratory report.
entries.zh: 她先比较了两个样品的原子吸收分光光度分析结果，再准备实验室报告。

entries.meaningZh: 非裔美国人英语〔英语变体〕
entries.en: The course examines African American Vernacular English (AAVE) without treating its speakers as a uniform group.
entries.zh: 那门课程研究非裔美国人英语，但不把使用这一英语变体的人视为完全相同的群体。

entries.en: The old diary includes a sketch made during her stay on Abadan Island.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记里有一幅速写，绘于她在阿巴丹岛停留期间。

entries.en: The evening class taught us the ABC's of bicycle maintenance before we touched any tools.
entries.zh: 夜校那门课在我们动用任何工具之前，先教了自行车保养的基础知识。

entries.en: The student compared two translations of the Book of Abdias before writing her essay.
entries.zh: 那名学生先比较了《俄巴底亚书》的两个译本，再写论文。

entries.en: An Abenaki lent several paintings to the exhibition and attended its opening with her family.
entries.zh: 一位阿布纳基人把几幅画借给了展览，并与家人一起参加了开幕活动。

entries.en: A fellow Aberdonian offered her a seat at the crowded cafe's only large table.
entries.zh: 另一位阿伯丁人请她坐到那家拥挤咖啡馆里唯一的大桌旁。

entries.meaningZh: 国际法协会美国分会〔机构缩写 ABILA〕
entries.en: She consulted the archived American Branch of the International Law Association (ABILA) conference programme for her bibliography.
entries.zh: 她为编写参考书目，查阅了国际法协会美国分会那份存档的会议日程册。

entries.en: An Abkhas studying photography volunteered to take pictures at our community event.
entries.zh: 一位学习摄影的阿布哈斯人主动提出为我们的社区活动拍照。

entries.en: The researcher compared the passage in Abkhasian with an English translation before revising her notes.
entries.zh: 研究者先把那段阿布哈斯语文字与一个英译本比较，再修改笔记。

entries.en: She studied the manuscript in Abnaki alongside the editor's notes on damaged pages.
entries.zh: 她研读那份阿布纳基语手稿时，同时参考了编辑对受损书页所作的注释。

entries.en: The box from Abruzzi arrived with its string intact but one corner badly crushed.
entries.zh: 来自阿布鲁齐的箱子送到时，捆绳完好，但一个角被压坏了。

entries.en: He telephoned his cousin in Abuja to ask whether the parcel had arrived.
entries.zh: 他给在阿布贾的堂表亲打电话，询问包裹是否已经送到。

entries.en: The artist chose a sketch of Abukir Bay for the cover of her travel journal.
entries.zh: 那位艺术家选了一幅阿布吉尔湾速写，作为旅行日志的封面。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拜多斯〔小亚细亚古城〕
entries.en: The lecturer compared two reconstructions of the ancient city of Abydos in Asia Minor.
entries.zh: 讲师比较了两种对小亚细亚古城阿拜多斯的复原呈现。

entries.en: The historian studied the headland of Abyla as it appeared on two old maps.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家研究了两张旧地图所呈现的阿比拉海岬。

entries.en: The old travel narrative describes the author's long wait in Accho for a missing companion.
entries.zh: 那篇旧旅行记述写到，作者在亚柯久久等候一位不见踪影的同伴。

entries.en: The students compared the depictions of Achaea in two historical atlases borrowed from the library.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了从图书馆借来的两本历史地图集中对亚该亚的呈现。

entries.en: The historian compared two accounts of Achaean customs before preparing her lecture.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家在准备讲课之前，比较了两份有关古代亚加亚人习俗的记述。

entries.en: A young Achaian waits outside the palace in the student's unfinished historical story.
entries.zh: 在那名学生尚未写完的历史故事中，一个年轻的亚该亚人在宫殿外等候。

entries.en: The stage designer placed the Acheron behind a curtain of grey cloth.
entries.zh: 舞台设计师把神话中的冥河安排在一层灰布幕的后方。

entries.en: An Achomawi offered to guide the visitors through the community's art exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位阿丘马维人主动提出带访客参观社区的艺术展。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the old Achromycin prescription before answering the caller's question.
entries.zh: 药剂师先核对了那张旧的Achromycin四环素处方，再回答来电者的问题。

entries.en: She gave me a photograph of Aconcagua with a short message written on the back.
entries.zh: 她给了我一张阿空加瓜山的照片，背面写着一条简短留言。

entries.en: The historian compared the descriptions of Acragas in two old travel accounts.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了两份旧旅行记述中对阿克拉加斯的描写。

entries.meaningZh: 阿克利纶〔纺织材料商品名〕
entries.en: She placed a piece of Acrilan beside the cotton lining to compare their colours.
entries.zh: 她把一块阿克利纶放在棉布衬里旁，比对它们的颜色。

entries.en: The researcher discussed the ACTH measurements with her supervisor before revising the chart.
entries.zh: 研究员先与导师讨论了促肾上腺皮质激素的测量数据，再修改图表。

entries.meaningZh: 含曲普利啶的药品〔商品名〕
entries.en: The pharmacist discussed the Actifed tablets with her before she bought any cold medicine.
entries.zh: 在她购买任何感冒药之前，药剂师和她谈了Actifed片剂的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 安贺拉眼药水〔药品商品名〕
entries.en: She asked the pharmacist about Acular eye drops before collecting the prescription.
entries.zh: 她取处方药之前，向药剂师询问了安贺拉眼药水的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 腺苷脱氨酶缺乏型重症联合免疫缺陷病
entries.en: The review of ADA-SCID research distinguished unanswered questions from established observations.
entries.zh: 那篇关于腺苷脱氨酶缺乏型重症联合免疫缺陷病研究的综述，区分了尚待解答的问题与已有的观察结果。

entries.en: A letter sent from Adalia lay among the family's old travel documents.
entries.zh: 一封从阿黛丽亚寄出的信夹在那家人的旧旅行文件中。

entries.en: The director asked the actor playing Adapa to pause before the next line.
entries.zh: 导演让扮演巴比伦神话人物Adapa的演员停顿一下，再说下一句台词。

entries.meaningZh: 盐酸多虑平〔药品商品名〕
entries.en: The medical historian compared two old advertisements for Adapin while preparing the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 那位医学史研究者在编写展览图录时，比较了两则盐酸多虑平药品Adapin的旧广告。

entries.en: The lecturer discussed ADH measurements without drawing conclusions about any individual patient's diagnosis.
entries.zh: 讲师讨论了抗利尿激素的测量数据，没有据此判断任何一位患者的诊断结果。

entries.en: Her pencil sketch of the Adige River survived after most of the photographs were lost.
entries.zh: 大部分照片遗失后，她那幅阿迪杰河铅笔速写仍保存了下来。

entries.en: She replaced the final Adonic with a shorter line during the poetry workshop.
entries.zh: 诗歌工作坊上，她把末尾那行阿多尼斯格诗句改成了更短的一行。

entries.en: The archived report described an ADPS that processed the company's payroll records.
entries.zh: 那份存档报告描述了一套处理该公司工资记录的自动数据处理系统。

entries.en: The family kept several letters sent from Adrianople in a faded leather case.
entries.zh: 那家人把几封从阿德里安堡寄出的信保存在一个褪色的皮盒里。

entries.meaningZh: 阿德里亚诺波利斯〔城市古名〕
entries.en: The historian traced the route to Adrianopolis in the traveller's unfinished manuscript.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家根据旅者未完成的手稿，追查前往阿德里亚诺波利斯的路线。

entries.en: Her essay on Adventism examines the letters without assuming that the reader shares their religious beliefs.
entries.zh: 她那篇关于基督复临论的文章分析了那些信件，并未假定读者认同信中的宗教信仰。

entries.en: An Adzhar studying architecture helped us arrange the drawings for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位学习建筑的札尔人帮我们布置了展览上的画稿。

entries.en: The memoir's account of Adzharia ends abruptly when several pages of the notebook go missing.
entries.zh: 回忆录对阿扎尔的记述，因为笔记本遗失了几页而突然中断。

entries.en: We compared two old drawings of the Aegates Islands before arranging the display.
entries.zh: 我们比较了两幅加特斯群岛的旧画，再布置展览。

entries.en: She left her raincoat with friends on Aegina Island and collected it the following summer.
entries.zh: 她把雨衣留在埃伊纳岛的朋友那里，在随后的那个夏天取了回来。

entries.meaningZh: 埃癸斯托斯〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The actor playing Aegisthus returned to the rehearsal room after changing his costume.
entries.zh: 扮演埃癸斯托斯的演员换好戏服后，回到了排练室。

entries.en: The historian compared two old maps showing the Aegospotami River without assuming that either was accurate.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了两张标有伊哥斯波塔米河的旧地图，并未认定其中任何一张一定准确。

entries.meaningZh: 伊哥斯波塔米河〔另一拼法〕
entries.en: The illustrator revised her drawing of the Aegospotamos River after consulting an old atlas.
entries.zh: 插画师查阅一本旧地图集后，修改了所画的伊哥斯波塔米河。

entries.en: Her essay compares the descriptions of Aeolia in the two historical texts we studied.
entries.zh: 她的论文比较了我们研读的那两份历史文本中对埃俄利亚的描写。

entries.meaningZh: 伊欧里斯语〔古希腊方言〕
entries.en: The student read the passage in Aeolic before consulting the modern translation.
entries.zh: 那名学生先读了那段伊欧里斯语文字，再查阅现代译本。

entries.en: The damaged travel account offered only a brief description of Aeolis before breaking off.
entries.zh: 那份受损的旅行记述只简短描写了伊奥利亚，便中断了。

entries.meaningZh: 埃俄罗斯〔神话中的风神〕
entries.en: The illustrator gave Aeolus a larger space on the page during her second draft.
entries.zh: 插画师画第二稿时，在纸上给风神埃俄罗斯留出了更大的空间。

entries.meaningZh: 埃尔特克斯网眼织物〔商标名〕
entries.en: He chose blue Aertex for the shirt and asked for matching thread.
entries.zh: 他为那件衬衫选了蓝色的埃尔特克斯网眼织物，并要了颜色相配的线。

entries.en: The director discussed the play's Aeschylean tone without claiming that it copied any ancient text.
entries.zh: 导演讨论了这部戏的埃斯库罗斯风格，但没有声称它照搬了任何古代文本。

entries.meaningZh: 埃斯科拉庇俄斯〔神话中的医神〕
entries.en: The exhibition's discussion of Aesculapius focused on artistic representation rather than medical advice.
entries.zh: 展览对医神埃斯科拉庇俄斯的讨论着重于艺术呈现，而非医疗建议。

entries.en: The Aesir appear together in the illustrator's imagined banquet scene.
entries.zh: 在插画师构想的宴会场景中，北欧神话的诸主神一同出现。

entries.meaningZh: 抽象语言族〔形式语言理论〕
entries.en: The tutor asked whether the proposed AFL satisfied the assumptions in the theorem.
entries.zh: 导师问，所提出的那个抽象语言族是否满足定理中的假设。

entries.en: She arranged the Afrasian travel photographs by date rather than by country.
entries.zh: 她把那些亚非地区的旅行照片按日期排列，而不是按国家排列。

entries.en: The historical novel follows an Afrikander who gives up farming to study painting.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说讲述了一位放弃务农、转而学习绘画的南非荷兰裔人的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 美国空军研究实验室〔机构名〕
entries.en: She consulted the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) archive while preparing a history of the conference.
entries.zh: 她在编写那次会议的历史时，查阅了美国空军研究实验室的档案。

entries.en: The memoir follows a young Afro-American who leaves home to study painting.
entries.zh: 那本回忆录讲述了一位离家学习绘画的年轻非裔美国人的经历。

entries.en: The library organised an Afro-Asian film season with discussions after each screening.
entries.zh: 图书馆安排了一个亚非电影展映季，每场放映后都有讨论。

entries.en: She returned the Afro-wig to the costume cupboard after the final rehearsal.
entries.zh: 最后一次排练结束后，她把那顶爆炸头假发放回了戏服柜。

entries.meaningZh: 美国空军太空司令部〔历史机构名〕
entries.en: The historian found an old Air Force Space Command (AFSPC) brochure among the donated papers.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家在获捐文件中找到了一本美国空军太空司令部的旧宣传册。

entries.meaningZh: 阿格赛兹拖网〔完整表达 Agassiz trawl〕
entries.en: The museum borrowed an Agassiz trawl for an exhibition about marine research equipment.
entries.zh: 博物馆为一场介绍海洋研究设备的展览借来了一张阿格赛兹拖网。

entries.meaningZh: 阿格狄斯提斯〔神话人物〕
entries.en: The sculptor placed her unfinished study of Agdistis beside two drawings for the same project.
entries.zh: 雕塑家把尚未完成的阿格狄斯提斯习作，放在同一项目的两幅画稿旁。

entries.en: The reading group compared two scholarly accounts of Aggeus before discussing their disagreements.
entries.zh: 读书小组先比较了两份关于先知哈该的学术记述，再讨论两者的分歧。

entries.en: The story follows the family through Aghan as they prepare for a long journey.
entries.zh: 故事写这家人在印度历Aghan月间为一段长途旅行作准备的经历。

entries.en: The artist moved Aglaia to the left of the composition to balance the other figures.
entries.zh: 艺术家把美慧女神Aglaia移到画面左侧，使其与其他人物形成平衡。

entries.en: The class compared two artistic portrayals of Agni without judging the worshippers' beliefs.
entries.zh: 课堂上，大家比较了两种对火神阿格尼的艺术描绘，没有评判信奉者的信仰。

entries.en: We posted the spare keys to Agrigento after realising that they were still in our suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们发现备用钥匙还在手提箱里后，把它们寄到了阿格里真托。

entries.meaningZh: 陆军高性能计算研究中心〔历史机构名〕
entries.en: The archived Army High Performance Computing Research Center (AHPCRC) newsletter helped her date the correspondence.
entries.zh: 那份存档的陆军高性能计算研究中心通讯，帮助她确定了书信的年代。

entries.en: The director discussed Ahriman's costume with the designer before the first rehearsal.
entries.zh: 首次排练之前，导演与设计师讨论了神话中恶灵Ahriman的戏服。

entries.en: An ahura stands beside the human figures in the illustrator's imagined Zoroastrian scene.
entries.zh: 在插画师构想的祆教场景中，一位善神站在人类形象旁。

entries.en: The travel diary ends with a quiet afternoon spent sketching on Ahvenanmaa.
entries.zh: 那本旅行日记以在阿维南马群岛安静写生的一个午后收尾。

entries.en: The illustrator darkened the background behind Aidoneus but left the figure itself unfinished.
entries.zh: 插画师加深了冥王Aidoneus身后的背景，却没有完成该人物本身。

entries.en: Our friends on Aigina kept the forgotten suitcase until we could arrange its return.
entries.zh: 我们在艾伊娜岛的朋友保管着那个落下的手提箱，直到我们能安排把它送回。

entries.en: The old diary describes an unexpected meeting in Aix-la-Chapelle during a journey interrupted by illness.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记描述了旅者因病耽搁行程期间，在亚琛的一次意外相遇。

entries.en: She telephoned a friend in Akaba to explain why she had missed the meeting.
entries.zh: 她给在亚喀巴的朋友打电话，解释自己为何错过了会面。

entries.en: An Akan studying photography offered to help us arrange the community exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位学习摄影的阿坎人主动提出帮我们布置社区展览。

entries.en: An Akha travelling with her daughter lent us an umbrella outside the crowded station.
entries.zh: 一位带着女儿旅行的阿卡族人在拥挤的车站外借给我们一把伞。

entries.en: The seminar examined the Akhbari school through several texts with contrasting interpretations.
entries.zh: 研讨课通过几份解读各异的文本，研究了阿赫巴尔学派。

entries.meaningZh: 奥克亨那坦〔古埃及法老〕
entries.en: The student questioned the film's portrayal of Akhenaten after comparing it with the assigned reading.
entries.zh: 那名学生把影片与指定阅读材料比较后，对影片中奥克亨那坦的形象提出了疑问。

entries.en: Several letters sent from Akmola were folded inside the traveller's old account book.
entries.zh: 几封从阿克莫拉寄出的信折好后，夹在旅者的旧账本里。

entries.en: The researcher studied the passage in Akwa'ala alongside the manuscript's handwritten notes.
entries.zh: 研究者研读那段阿卡瓦拉语文字时，同时参考了手稿中的手写注释。

entries.en: Her historical essay examines al-Fatah through archived documents rather than personal recollections alone.
entries.zh: 她的历史论文通过存档文件研究法塔赫，而非仅仅依赖个人回忆。

entries.en: The historian compared two accounts of Al-hakim before discussing how their authors differed.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家先比较了两份关于历史哈里发Al-hakim的记述，再讨论两位作者的差异。

entries.en: The lecturer recommended a biography of al-Haytham to accompany the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 讲师建议将一本关于历史学者al-Haytham的传记，与展览图录配合阅读。

entries.en: The parcel from Al-Hudaydah contained several notebooks wrapped in a faded cloth.
entries.zh: 来自荷台达的包裹里有几本笔记本，用一块褪色的布包着。

entries.meaningZh: 伊拉克〔阿拉伯语国名形式〕
entries.en: In the memoir, their journey through Al-Iraq ends with a long visit to an old friend.
entries.zh: 在那本回忆录中，他们途经伊拉克的旅程，以一次对老友的长时间拜访结束。

entries.meaningZh: 圣战组织〔埃及历史组织名〕
entries.en: The historian compared archived reports about al-Jihad without treating every allegation as an established fact.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了关于埃及圣战组织的存档报告，没有把每项指控都当作既定事实。

entries.meaningZh: 奥玛乌纳〔马来西亚组织名〕
entries.en: The researcher compared the descriptions of al-Ma'unah in two archived reports.
entries.zh: 研究者比较了两份存档报告中对奥玛乌纳组织的描述。

entries.en: The essay discusses al-Muhajiroun through historical documents without endorsing the organisation's views.
entries.zh: 那篇文章通过历史文件讨论穆哈吉荣组织，没有认同该组织的观点。

entries.en: We found the missing address among the letters sent from Al-Mukalla.
entries.zh: 我们在从木卡拉寄来的那些信中，找到了丢失的地址。

entries.en: The journalist checked the sources of the archived reports about al-Qa'ida before quoting them.
entries.zh: 那位记者核查了有关基地组织的存档报告的来源，再引用报告内容。

entries.en: The reading group compared two translations of al-Qur'an without assuming agreement on religious questions.
entries.zh: 读书小组比较了《古兰经》的两个译本，没有假定大家在宗教问题上意见一致。

entries.meaningZh: 独一性原理〔伊斯兰教神学〕
entries.en: The seminar compared two interpretations of al-Tawhid without asking students to adopt either position.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了对伊斯兰教独一性原理的两种解释，没有要求学生接受其中任何一种立场。

entries.en: Her study of al-Ummah distinguishes contemporary documents from accounts written much later.
entries.zh: 她对乌玛社团的研究，区分了当时的文件与很久之后才写下的记述。

entries.en: The students compared two portrayals of Alaric before discussing the historical novel's choices.
entries.zh: 学生们先比较了两种阿拉里克形象，再讨论那部历史小说的创作取舍。

entries.meaningZh: 阿比尔派信徒〔历史用语，复数〕
entries.en: The historian compared accounts of the Albigenses without adopting the hostile language of their opponents.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了关于阿比尔派信徒的记述，没有采用其反对者带有敌意的措辞。

entries.en: The historian separated the Albigensian letters from later accounts written by their opponents.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家把阿比尔派教徒的信件与后来由其反对者写下的记述分开。

entries.en: The seminar on Albigensianism encouraged students to compare conflicting accounts rather than accept one uncritically.
entries.zh: 那场讨论阿比尔派教义的研讨课鼓励学生比较相互矛盾的记述，而不是不加批判地接受其中一种。

entries.en: The postcard from Alborg arrived long after we had returned from our own journey.
entries.zh: 来自奥尔堡的明信片到达时，我们自己的旅程早已结束。

entries.en: Her essay on Alcaeus compares the choices made by two translators working from the same passage.
entries.zh: 她关于阿尔凯奥斯的论文，比较了两位译者翻译同一段文字时作出的选择。

entries.en: The actor playing Alcides left his costume at the theatre after the final performance.
entries.zh: 最后一场演出结束后，扮演阿尔喀德斯的演员把戏服留在了剧院。

entries.en: The student compared two photographs of Alcyone before asking which telescope had been used.
entries.zh: 那名学生比较了两张昴宿六的照片，然后询问使用了哪架望远镜。

entries.en: She chose a photograph of Aldebaran for the cover of her astronomy notebook.
entries.zh: 她选了一张毕宿五的照片，作为天文笔记本的封面。

entries.en: The illustrator revised Alecto's expression after discussing the scene with the theatre director.
entries.zh: 插画师与剧院导演讨论了那一场景后，修改了神话人物阿勒克图的表情。

entries.meaningZh: 阿勒颇〔城市的法语名称〕
entries.en: The letters sent from Alep were still bundled together in the traveller's old trunk.
entries.zh: 从阿勒颇寄出的那些信，仍捆在一起，放在旅者的旧箱子里。

entries.en: An Aleut travelling with her daughter shared our table while the cafe filled up.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆里的人渐渐多起来，一位带着女儿旅行的阿留申人与我们拼了桌。

entries.en: She compared two collections of Alexandrian photographs before choosing material for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 她比较了两批亚历山大港的照片，再为展览挑选材料。

entries.en: The poet rewrote the final Alexandrine after reading the stanza aloud to her classmates.
entries.zh: 那位诗人把这一诗节朗读给同学听后，重写了末尾那行亚历山大格式诗句。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔及尔〔城市的法语名称〕
entries.en: The French traveller's account of Alger includes a meeting with an old school friend.
entries.zh: 那位法国旅者关于阿尔及尔的记述中，写到与一位老同学会面的经历。

entries.en: The programmer rewrote the example in ALGOL before comparing it with the original version.
entries.zh: 程序员先用ALGOL算法语言重写了那个示例，再与原版比较。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔冈纪的〔旧地质术语〕
entries.en: The historian compared the Algonkian formations shown on two old geological maps.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家比较了两张旧地质图所呈现的阿尔冈纪地层。

entries.en: An Algonkin brought several framed photographs to the exhibition and helped us hang them.
entries.zh: 一位阿尔冈琴人把几张装框的照片带到展览现场，并帮我们挂了起来。

entries.en: The student borrowed two books about Alhacen before starting her history essay.
entries.zh: 那名学生在开始写历史论文之前，借了两本关于历史学者Alhacen的书。

entries.en: The lecturer distinguished reliable accounts of Alhazen from later stories with uncertain sources.
entries.zh: 讲师把关于阿尔哈曾的可靠记述，与后来那些来源尚不确定的故事区分开。

entries.meaningZh: 平铺富贵草〔完整表达 Allegheny spurge〕
entries.en: She sketched the Allegheny spurge beside the garden path while we arranged the benches.
entries.zh: 我们摆放长凳时，她画下了园中小径旁的平铺富贵草。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the family postpones its journey until after Allhallows.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说中，一家人把旅程推迟到诸圣日之后。

entries.en: The old diary describes several neighbours gathering for supper at Allhallowtide.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记记述了几位邻居在诸圣时节聚餐的情景。

entries.en: The historical novel introduces an Almoravid who carries a letter between two distant towns.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说介绍了一位在两个相距遥远的城镇之间送信的穆拉比德人。

entries.en: Her interest in alpinism began with photographs, long before she considered joining a climbing club.
entries.zh: 她还远未考虑加入登山俱乐部时，就已因照片对高山登山运动产生了兴趣。

entries.meaningZh: 抗淋巴细胞血清〔医学缩写〕
entries.en: Her review of early ALS research carefully separated experimental observations from later clinical claims.
entries.zh: 她对早期抗淋巴细胞血清研究的综述，仔细区分了实验观察与后来的临床主张。

entries.en: The historian compared two fictional depictions of London's Alsatia before consulting the older maps.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家先比较了两种对伦敦历史地区Alsatia的虚构描写，再查阅较早的地图。

entries.en: The pharmacist reviewed the Altace prescription with him before he left the counter.
entries.zh: 他离开柜台之前，药剂师和他一起核对了那张雷米普利制剂Altace的处方。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔泰语系的〔语言学假说〕
entries.en: The seminar examined the proposed Altaic family without treating the linguistic relationship as established.
entries.zh: 研讨课考察了所提出的阿尔泰语系，没有把这种语言亲缘关系当作定论。

entries.en: The photograph of Altair was blurred, so she asked whether another image was available.
entries.zh: 牵牛星的那张照片模糊不清，于是她问是否还有别的图像。

entries.en: We sent the forgotten umbrella to Altoona with a note apologising for the delay.
entries.zh: 我们把那把落下的伞寄到阿尔图纳，并附上一张为延误致歉的便条。

entries.meaningZh: 硫酸间羟异丙肾上腺素制剂〔商品名〕
entries.en: The historian found an old Alupent advertisement among the medical journal's loose pages.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者在医学期刊散落的书页中，找到了一则Alupent硫酸间羟异丙肾上腺素制剂的旧广告。

entries.en: The family discussed Alzheimer's with the care team before planning the next visit.
entries.zh: 家人与照护团队讨论了阿尔茨海默病的情况，然后安排下一次探访。

entries.en: The musician left her Amati in its case until the rehearsal room was ready.
entries.zh: 那位音乐家把阿玛蒂提琴留在琴盒里，等排练室准备好。

entries.meaningZh: 阿蒙拉〔神话中的太阳神〕
entries.en: The designer compared two drawings of Amen-Ra while planning the exhibition's introductory panel.
entries.zh: 设计师为展览规划介绍板时，比较了两幅太阳神阿蒙拉的图画。

entries.en: The editor decided not to Americanize the dialogue in the British edition of the novel.
entries.zh: 编辑决定不把这部小说英版中的对话改成美国式表达。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲印第安人的〔较旧称呼〕
entries.en: The book compares the weaving traditions of several Amerind communities without treating them as identical.
entries.zh: 那本书比较了几个美洲印第安社群的编织传统，没有把它们视为完全相同。

entries.en: The parcel from Amhara contained a small painting and several letters wrapped together.
entries.zh: 来自阿姆哈拉的包裹里，有一幅小画和几封包在一起的信。

entries.meaningZh: 阿蒙拉〔神话中的太阳神〕
entries.en: The illustrator redrew Amon-Ra after deciding that the first composition was too crowded.
entries.zh: 插画师认为第一稿的构图过于拥挤，便重画了太阳神阿蒙拉。

entries.en: She found the drawing of the Amur River folded inside a book of travel essays.
entries.zh: 她在一本旅行随笔集中，发现了那幅折起来的阿穆尔河图画。

entries.meaningZh: 异戊巴比妥钠制剂〔商品名〕
entries.en: The archivist found an old Amytal Sodium advertisement between two medical conference programmes.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在两本医学会议节目册之间，找到了一则异戊巴比妥钠制剂Amytal Sodium的旧广告。

entries.en: She brought the Anaprox packaging to the pharmacy because the printed instructions were difficult to read.
entries.zh: 她把萘普生钠制剂Anaprox的包装带到药房，因为印在上面的说明难以看清。

entries.en: The photograph of Mount Anapurna reminded her of a sketchbook she had lost during the journey.
entries.zh: 阿那普那山的那张照片，让她想起了旅途中遗失的一本速写本。

entries.meaningZh: 阿那克西曼德〔哲学家名〕
entries.en: The seminar on Anaximander encouraged us to distinguish surviving evidence from later interpretation.
entries.zh: 关于阿那克西曼德的研讨课鼓励我们区分现存证据与后来的解读。

entries.en: We placed the photograph of Mount Ancohuma beside the travel diary, not inside the crowded album.
entries.zh: 我们把汉科乌马山的照片放在旅行日记旁，没有放进那本已很拥挤的相册。

entries.en: Her photographs of the Andes filled two albums and a small wooden box.
entries.zh: 她那些安第斯山脉的照片，装满了两本相册和一个小木盒。

entries.en: She kept the Andorran postcards separate from the rest of her travel collection.
entries.zh: 她把那些安道尔明信片与其余的旅行收藏品分开存放。

entries.meaningZh: 安德瓦里〔北欧神话人物〕
entries.en: The actor playing Andvari asked the costume designer to shorten the sleeves before rehearsal.
entries.zh: 扮演安德瓦里的演员请服装设计师在排练前把袖子改短。

entries.en: The sketch of the Angara River had a coffee stain across one corner.
entries.zh: 那幅安加拉河速写的一角上有一片咖啡渍。

entries.en: The family kept the drawings made during their stay on Anglesea in a separate folder.
entries.zh: 那家人把在安格尔西岛停留期间画的画稿，保存在另一个文件夹里。

entries.en: The translator questioned whether the anglicisation of every place name would make the story clearer.
entries.zh: 译者质疑，把每个地名都英语化是否会让故事更清楚。

entries.en: The editor retained the Anglicism because it suited the British narrator's voice.
entries.zh: 编辑保留了那个英国习语，因为它符合那位英国叙述者的口吻。

entries.en: The museum organised an Anglo-American photography exhibition using loans from several private collections.
entries.zh: 博物馆借用几个私人收藏中的作品，举办了一场英美摄影展。

entries.en: The students compared two accounts of the Anglo-French negotiations before discussing their differences.
entries.zh: 学生们先比较了两份关于英法谈判的记述，再讨论它们之间的差异。

entries.meaningZh: 讲英语的犹太人及其文化的
entries.en: Her research into Anglo-Jewish literature began with a box of family letters.
entries.zh: 她从一箱家族书信入手，开始研究与讲英语的犹太社群及其文化相关的文学。

entries.meaningZh: 盎格鲁-诺曼语〔中世纪英国的法语〕
entries.en: She translated the passage from Anglo-Norman before comparing it with a modern French version.
entries.zh: 她先翻译了那段盎格鲁-诺曼语文字，再把它与一个现代法语版本比较。

entries.en: The tutor asked us to compare two descriptions of Anglo-Saxon clothing in the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 导师让我们比较展览图录中两段有关盎格鲁撒克逊人服饰的描述。

entries.meaningZh: 对英国事物的狂热迷恋
entries.en: The novel gently mocks the landlord's Anglomania through his extravagant imitation of English country houses.
entries.zh: 小说通过那位房东对英国乡间宅邸的奢华模仿，温和地嘲笑了他对英国事物的狂热迷恋。

entries.meaningZh: 对英国及其习俗的喜爱
entries.en: Her Anglophilia was obvious in the books, photographs and theatre programmes filling her study.
entries.zh: 她书房里满是书、照片和戏剧节目单，显然看得出她对英国的喜爱。

entries.meaningZh: 对英国及其习俗的厌恶或恐惧
entries.en: The historian warned against confusing criticism of a government's decisions with Anglophobia.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家提醒大家，不要把对政府决策的批评与对英国及其习俗的厌恶或恐惧混为一谈。

entries.en: An Angolese studying art lent several drawings to our community exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位学习艺术的安哥拉本地族群成员，把几幅画借给了我们的社区展览。

entries.en: Our friends in Annaba offered to send the books after we had found a new address.
entries.zh: 我们在安纳巴的朋友提出，等我们找到新地址后就把那些书寄来。
